Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: Hi there! Do you need anything?

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: Sorry, I'm new here, is there anything I could help you with?

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: Nothing in particular. It's a surprisingly slow party. Not much work to be done.

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: Are you on your brake, then?

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: Not until Ms. Pearce says so. Maybe in an hour or so? Care to join me then?

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: I'd love to!

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: See you then

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: Soo, you will just wait here?

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: Yes! Ms. Pearce is really strict...

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: Oh... alright, see you later

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: See you then

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: There you are! Finished with your work now?

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: Nooo... somebody was complaining that their room is dirty!

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: Wow, what happened?

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: I would like to know before Ms. Pearce gets to know...

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: Oh... true...

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: What about you? How are you doing here?

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: Normally I would give you a tour... But we are a bit busy...

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: Makes sense...

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: Hey, I have a question

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: Oh! Yes! Tell me

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: Are all of those rooms booked?

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: Em... I don't think so?

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: Really? Not a lot folks stay here?

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: I would say so...

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: Alright, thanks

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: You are welcome!

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: Do you need anything?

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: Oh, sorry, I was just admiring an art piece

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: But there is none here..?

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: *You smile*

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: Alright??

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: There you are! Finished with your work now?

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: Finished and free, my friend. Of course until someone breaks a glass again...

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: Fingers crossed.

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: What do you usually do here to relax?

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: Nothing in particular... Do you have something in mind?

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: Oh do I~
*You pull her into an empty room*

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: There you are! Finished with your work now?

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: Finished and free, my friend. Of course until someone breaks a glass again...

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: Fingers crossed.

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: What do you usually do here to relax after work?

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: Nothing in particular... Do you have something in mind?

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: Oh do I~
*You pull her into an empty room*

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: I'm still shaking. That was crazy!

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: Good thing noone saw us.

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: I don't even want to think about something like that!

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: I'm still shaking. That was crazy!

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: Want to try something even more crazy?

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: No way!

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: Okay, what is it?

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: See this guy over there? The critic?

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: I want to get back on him for acting so high and mighty; spike his drink a little.

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: What!

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: It's nothing that strong... He'll just look like he got properly wine drunk!

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: Can you help me with that?

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: I don't know... I don't want to get fired...

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: Trust me, nobody is gonna know~

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: I can't say no to you, can I?
*You give her a pill she dissolves in the next drink Carl will drink.*

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: I hope you keep working here. Today was so exciting!

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: Glad to hear it.

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: Hello Miss! May I help you?

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: No need, thank you very much

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: Yes, tell me when You need something.

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: Hello missster..?

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: Oh silly one, I am a girl

Lines.Name: May Scott
Lines.Text: Aaaa.. I am so sorry!

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: No need, I will take it as a compliment

Lines.Name: MC
Lines.Text: Especielly from a cute like you you~
